Create a taxID mapping file from a FASTA file

Source: R/vtamR_fun.R
write_taxid_mapping.Rd

Extracts sequence identifiers and NCBI taxonomic identifiers from FASTA headers and writes them as a two-column tab-separated file.

Usage

write_taxid_mapping(file, outfile)

Arguments

file

Character string: path to a FASTA file containing sequences with taxonomic identifiers in the header (format taxID=<number>).

outfile

Character string: path to the output file to be created. The file contains two tab-separated columns: seq_id and tax_id, without header or quotes.

Value

NULL; writes a tab-delimited file to outfile.

Details

The FASTA headers must contain a taxonomic identifier in the format: >SequenceName taxID=12345

  • Uses the internal helper read_fasta_to_df() to parse the FASTA file.

  • Only the first two space-separated elements of each FASTA header are used; any additional information is ignored.

  • The taxID= prefix is removed before converting values to numeric.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
write_taxid_mapping("input_sequences.fasta", "taxid_mapping.tsv")
} # }
